purpose: Bounded independent reconstruction authority derived from the two owner-authorized full/all processed-TOD captures; final FITS numerical payloads are not inputs.

full_ptc_input.projection: C++ llround(det_lat/effective_pixel_size_rad + (rows-1)/2) and corresponding det_lon/cols expression; rows, cols, pixel size, identity, and d_fsmp come from digest-bound realized mapmaking provenance, never final FITS.
full_ptc_input.detector_identity: Composite (network,kids_tone,uid,APT row index); UID alone is not required to be unique.
full_ptc_input.realization_sign_authority: Reproduce 64 scan-level signs from the unchanged registered seed-5489 Boost MT19937/uniform-int policy with randomize_dets=false; signs are not claimed to be a PTC NetCDF variable.
full_ptc_input.rate_provenance_binding: realized_raw_timestream_provenance_sha256 is distinct from realized_mapmaking_provenance_sha256 and binds telescope.fsmp/telescope.d_fsmp; the mapmaking digest separately binds projection, shape, WCS, target, and pixel size.

resource_gate.projection: Canonical sci-map-001-resource-projection-v1 document reconstructed from a digest-bound producer stream or discrepancy request; no operator byte count is accepted.
resource_gate.inventory: Canonical sci-map-001-resource-inventory-v1 document; roots and directories bind logical and allocated metadata, regular files are byte-hashed, and symlinks bind UTF-8 link text and resolved target without traversing target payloads; the producer recomputes the live inventory before writing.
required_checks: current logical apparent bytes plus projected incremental bytes is at most the ceiling
current allocated bytes plus projected incremental bytes is at most the ceiling
all governed roots share the recorded selected filesystem device
filesystem available bytes covers projected incremental bytes
inventory count, totals, canonical digest, exact roots, and live contents agree
projection digest, source digest, stage identity, and deterministic arithmetic agree
both full captures remain retained and automatic cleanup is false

sufficient_statistics.ordinary_array_bound: five*nscan*npixel + two*npixel + 64*nscan elements; no primitive-term axis

signal_numerator.identity: ordered sum of coefficient*sample_signal over contributing terms within each scan/pixel

weight.identity: ordered sum of positive finite coefficient over contributing terms within each scan/pixel
weight.claim: formal weight, normalization support, and science-policy support

kernel_numerator.identity: ordered sum of coefficient*sample_kernel over contributing terms within each scan/pixel

upstream_eligible_exposure.identity: ordered sum of binary64(1/telescope.d_fsmp) for upstream-eligible terms

retained_exposure.identity: ordered sum of binary64(1/telescope.d_fsmp) for contributing terms before normalization support

contributing_hits.identity: exact count after eligibility and finite-positive coefficient

realization_signs.identity: Boost MT19937 seed 5489, high-bit Rademacher stream, randomize_dets=false

sufficient_statistics.finite_policy: Eligible non-finite coefficients and contributing non-finite/overflowed signal or kernel terms fail closed; explicit invalid terms do not contribute.
sufficient_statistics.reduction_order: Terms are accumulated in exact source order within a scan/pixel; reconstruction folds scan planes in ascending scan_index. Integer fields are exact; binary64 comparisons use the unchanged registered regression bounds.

stream_digest_canonicalization.header: RFC8785-compatible sorted-key compact JSON restricted to integers/strings/lists/objects, prefixed by uint64 little-endian byte count
stream_digest_canonicalization.term_record: uint64 ordinal; int64 scan,detector,sample,network,row,col; uint8 geometric,apt_flagged,sample_flagged,upstream; float64 coefficient,signal,kernel,interval, all little-endian
stream_digest_canonicalization.chunk_boundaries: not encoded; digests are invariant to producer chunk size

deterministic_trace.scan_selection: scan indices 0, floor((nscan-1)/2), nscan-1, deduplicated while retaining all applicable role labels
deterministic_trace.detector_selection: For each selected scan and every active network, SHA-256-min composite detector identity separately for APT-valid and APT-flagged classes; sample flags never reclassify a detector.
deterministic_trace.selection_domain: candidate, campaign revision, raw-manifest digest, observation, array, network, scan identity/roles, detector state, detector UID, kids tone, and APT row index
deterministic_trace.class_absence: explicit JSON fact with present=false and no fabricated sequence
deterministic_trace.fixed_budget: exact sum of sample_count for each present selected detector-by-scan sequence
deterministic_trace.sample_identity: sample index is implicit from sequence_offsets; scan/detector identity occurs once in the selection descriptor, never once per sample
deterministic_trace.claim_limit: engineering falsification surface, not exhaustive external primitive coverage

focused_expansion.two_pass: plan-expansion counts and digests the exact selection; emit-expansion rereads the unchanged source and must reproduce count and digest
focused_expansion.target_required: exact observation/array/network plus either one scan identity and composite detector identity or one map pixel

scope_boundary: This validation-only representation cannot contact Unity, run Citlali, close MAP findings or dependencies, launch re-audit, or authorize cleanup.
